title: Side-scrolling action game set inside a haunted photocopier, where you play DUPE, a rejected office mascot who refuses to be thrown away. Looking for playtesters. Sharing some details on how the game was made, and will answer any questions.
author: One_Low8664
selftext:
[https://bug.games/games/carbon-body](https://bug.games/games/carbon-body)

I built it with Claude as about 10,600 lines of plain JavaScript with no engine, no libraries and no image or audio files, all compiled into one 700 KB HTML page. Since an LLM can't paint sprites but can write drawing code, everything is drawn at runtime on three ink layers (black, blue, orange) run through a fake photocopier effect with misaligned colors and boiling grain, which makes simple shapes look intentional, and all 11 music tracks are synthesized live with Web Audio. Claude can't play the game or watch video, so it wrote bots that play the real game and made this video by stepping the game frame by frame in headless Chrome, re-rendering the logged sounds offline and encoding with ffmpeg, with no screen recording. The most useful lesson: quick previews played out differently from the final render because the drawing code also used Math.random, and splitting it into separate random streams for the game logic and the drawing fixed it, which is worth checking in any game where you want replays or repeatable captures.
